  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Two-level DSEM roadmap}
  %\VignetteEngine{knitr::rmarkdown}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---

Two-level DSEM is a parity target, not a current estimator capability. The
planned model decomposes within-person dynamics from between-person variation
in means, lagged effects, covariate effects, and residual variances. Latent
centering and initial-condition choices must be explicit.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
model <- dsem_model("
  level: 1
    y ~ random(lag(y, 1))
  level: 2
    y ~ z
", id = "person", time = "occasion")
```

The current `dsem()` correctly rejects this model until examples 9.30–9.37 and
the associated recovery studies pass.
